Do not invent or change behavior, fields, owner permissions, menus, destinations, folders, notes, actions, numbers, login methods, AI functions, collaboration, team/account switchers, notification controls, task content, status indicators, overlays, or new copy. All visible text is limited to the exact labels listed above. Source authority remains commit 933d63d942b6499fee964f8a060c7b22b9d299d1, WS-001 (with WS-002/WS-098 navigation context). Every source control/function must survive; this is a visual-only revision.
